subject.title: [Bug] mergeAgentRunTerminalOutcome can discard user-visible success errors

question: When user cancellation races with a model completion containing output, should explicit cancellation remain authoritative, or should committed completion output make the run successful?
rationale: Both outcomes are defensible user-facing semantics, and the central helper intentionally owns precedence for all projections; source inspection alone cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Committed completion wins
options.body: Treat completion as successful only when the response was fully committed to the transcript or delivery path before cancellation became authoritative.

options.title: Cancellation always wins
options.body: Keep cancellation sticky and clarify that concurrently generated output does not change the final run status.

options.title: Expose a distinct race outcome
options.body: Represent completed-after-cancel as a separate terminal outcome so projections can explain that output finished while cancellation was requested.

recommendation.title: Committed completion wins
recommendation.body: Treat completion as successful only when the response was fully committed to the transcript or delivery path before cancellation became authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-path terminal-state contract needs repository-level agent-runtime ownership rather than a caller-local choice.
